title: Dollar account
description: Hold US dollars, add them from a bank account and withdraw them back.
goal_template: A dollar account app. Customers open an account, add US dollars from their own bank account, see their balance and recent activity, and withdraw back to their bank account. Show the amount and any fee before each transfer, and every document the product requires before the customer agrees.

screens.title: Account
screens.purpose: The balance and recent activity, from the product's lifecycle events that api/ receives on Mynt's webhook, with Add money and Withdraw.

screens.title: Open an account
screens.purpose: Opening the account: the product's journey, with its consents, required documents and the provider's hosted identity checks.

screens.title: Add money
screens.purpose: Add dollars from the customer's bank account: the amount and fee shown first, then the provider's hosted flow.

screens.title: Withdraw
screens.purpose: Withdraw dollars back to the customer's bank account: the amount and fee shown first, then the provider's hosted flow.

flows.title: Open an account
steps: api/ mints a client session for the signed-in customer (createClientSession)
web runs the product's journey: each consent before the action that needs it, each required document shown verbatim
the provider's hosted flow opens the account and returns with an outcome

flows.title: Add money
steps: show the offer's terms, the amount and the fee
start the provider's hosted funding flow (startAction) and send the customer to its redirect_url
api/ records the outcome from Mynt's webhook (verifyWebhook) and the balance updates

flows.title: Withdraw
steps: show the amount and the fee
start the provider's hosted withdrawal flow (startAction)
show its status until the webhook says it settled
